symptom: CE0129 "Administrator password has not been set" could not be resolved from MDL: `alter app security ( AdminPassword: '…' )` failed `alter app security has no property "AdminPassword"`
cause: Left out on purpose when AdminUserName was added (#1314), pending this issue; the backend had no writer for Security$ProjectSecurity.AdminPassword although gen offered SetAdminPassword
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_security.go (appSecurityKeys), mdl/executor/cmd_security_write.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/security_write.go (SetProjectAdminPassword), mdl/executor/cmd_security.go (show: set / not set)
insight: Measure what raises the error before deciding what to guard: on 11.13.0 a blank AdminPassword is CE0129 only at prototype/production (off: no error), and a password violating the project's password policy ('1' vs a 12-char minimum) raises nothing at any level — so mxcli refuses '' and adds no policy check of its own. Studio Pro's starter apps store '1'. Patch the BSON directly (top-level string + document length) on fixture copies to get the blank-password control, since MDL cannot write the fault; PedApp's ~1000 theme errors drown a summary, so compare the CE code multiset against the untouched copy. Never echo the value: exec says 'Admin password set', show says set / not set.
